property_summary: For every call to Collect by any caller, the reference C either reverts (if conditions fail) or, if it completes, it never causes any address's Acc(...).balance to decrease by more than the withdrawn amount in a single Collect call; the mutant that removes the nonReentrant_ check can allow a re-entrant attacker to cause an extra withdrawal so the recorded external recipient sees more drained (the reference thus preserves that after a successful Collect the attacker's Acc balance decreases by <= _am, but the mutant can make it decrease by > _am).
change_summary: Replace the nonReentrant_ modifier's require(!locked_) with no-op (always passes) by removing the require, allowing reentrancy.
